usedFor: Daftra holds invoices and products, and HubSpot receives notes on contacts through “Add Notes to Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Invoice Created” in Daftra, then “Add Notes to Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: An invoice is a billing event worth recording, and the action writes it as a contact note.

watchOut: “New Invoice Created” in Daftra is polling, and “Add Notes to Contact” needs a contact ID or email.
